conservative.read: This conservative approach focuses on capital preservation. Expect a modest target return of around 1.5% per month. The primary risk is missing out on potential upside if the market rallies strongly.

plan: Reduce exposure in leveraged ETFs and AI/Software.

Add a new, high-scoring opportunity from the scanner.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth potential.
It aims for a target return of approximately 2.5% per month.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting around 2.5% per month. It reduces concentrated risk while adding a promising new opportunity. The main risk is that the market moves against the blended strategy, leading to moderate drawdowns.

plan: Increase exposure in leveraged ETFs and AI/Software.
Add to existing leveraged positions to maximize potential gains.
Initiate a new position with a strong scanner signal.
This aggressive plan aims for high growth, targeting ~4% per month.
It embraces concentration and leverage, accepting higher risk.

aggressive.read: This aggressive growth plan targets approximately 4% per month by increasing leverage and concentration in high-conviction names. It accepts significantly higher potential drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses due to leverage and ETF rebalancing. Strict adherence to stops is paramount.

plan: Eliminate all leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names.
Reduce exposure to AI/Software leveraged plays.
Increase allocation to the income-focused ETF.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income generation.
It aims for a low target return of ~1% per month.

income.read: This income-focused plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions, targeting around 1% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leverage and volatile single names. The main risk is that the Net Asset Value (NAV) of holdings can still decline in a market downturn, impacting overall capital.
